Wbm the rain began to fall, King Lomapada, realising that 
the holy sage had entered the city, went out to meet him. 
Offering him humble and loving salutations, he presented him 
with the traditional gifts (arghya)' of water and food, and 
entreated him to grant the boon that his father Vibbandska 
sbould not visit his displessure on him. 
The king then took the youth to the inner apartments and 
united him in marriage to his daughter Sbanta. 
Deeply revered by the king, Rishyasringa lived happily in 
the capital with his bride, the Princess Sbanta.
